allocation_exceeds_area.fail: Stage {stage}: an allocation is larger than its area.

area_balance_not_closed.fail: Stage {stage}: the area balance does not close ({difference_m2} m2 difference).
area_balance_not_closed.suggestion: Allocate the remaining area or correct the site total.

area_overlap.fail: Stage {stage}: two areas of different kinds overlap.

declarant_mismatch_incoterm.fail: The declarant does not match who clears import under the incoterm.
declarant_mismatch_incoterm.suggestion: Check the declarant or the incoterm.

gate_limits_unknown.fail: Site entrance {gate} states no load limits.
gate_limits_unknown.suggestion: Enter the weight and dimension limits.

gate_load_exceeded.fail: {title}: the load exceeds the limits of the site entrance.
gate_load_exceeded.suggestion: Use another entrance or split the load.

heavy_without_permit.fail: {title}: heavy transport without a granted permit.

hs_code_invalid.suggestion: Use digits only, at least the minimum length.

incoterm_sea_only.fail: Incoterm {incoterm} is for sea transport only.
incoterm_sea_only.suggestion: Use FCA, CPT or CIP for other modes.

incoterm_unknown.fail: Incoterm {incoterm} is not in the pinned version.
incoterm_unknown.suggestion: Pick a term of the pinned version.

jit_late.fail: {title}: the just-in-time delivery comes after the takt start.

jit_too_early.fail: {title}: the just-in-time delivery comes earlier than its buffer allows.
jit_too_early.suggestion: Move it closer to the takt start.

media_capacity_short.suggestion: Increase the contracted capacity or reduce the demand.

media_late.fail: Stage {stage}: the {media} connection is promised after the stage starts.
media_late.suggestion: Agree an earlier date or a temporary supply.

neighbour_issue_overdue.fail: A complaint was due for a response on {due}.

permit_expired.fail: Permit {reference} has expired while transports remain.

permit_expiring.fail: Permit {reference} runs out soon while transports remain.

quiet_hours_conflict.fail: {title}: the window falls in the quiet hours.
quiet_hours_conflict.suggestion: Move it out of the quiet hours or obtain a night-work permit.

stage_without_site_setup.fail: Stage {stage} has no site setup area.
stage_without_site_setup.suggestion: Allocate an area for offices and welfare.

stage_without_storage.fail: Stage {stage} has no storage or laydown area.
stage_without_storage.suggestion: Allocate a storage or laydown area.

window_outside_permit.fail: {title}: the window is outside the permit.
window_outside_permit.suggestion: Move the window or extend the permit.

zone_not_mapped.fail: Laydown zone {zone} is not linked to a site area.
zone_not_mapped.suggestion: Link it to its planned area.
